title: runner: a coder started just before a runner restart never gets its brief and sits idle
author: dtubb
body:
A coder window started just before a runner restart never gets its brief: no tell event, no session log, the Pi window idle while the item shows coding.
Spec `pipeline.messages` (deterministic-conductor.md).
Acceptance: on start-up (and each tick) the runner finds every coding item whose worker has no delivered tell of its brief and sends it, journaling the tell.
Files: pipeline/runner.py (_step, the coding branch), pipeline/core.py (state replays the tell event with delivered; tell).
Test: pipeline/tests/test_runner.py::test_a_coder_without_its_brief_gets_it_after_a_restart (new; use the fake_coder fixture: start an item, drop its tell from the journal, run `runner.tick()`, expect the brief told once).
Failing command: PYTHONPATH=. OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider pipeline/tests/test_runner.py::test_a_coder_without_its_brief_gets_it_after_a_restart
Diff bound: 90
